description: Update an existing play log row owned by the authenticated user. Use the play log id from a prior list — these are NOT game ids. playedAt must be today or earlier. Pass any subset of fields to update; omitted fields are left untouched. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

playLogId.description: Play log row UUID to update — not a game id.

playedAt.description: Play date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or earlier.

score.description: Score on the machine, not a fun rating.

name: kineticist_update_play_log
title: Edit a play
